    Labels

    • labels.list List DevOps labels
    • labels.create Create a DevOps label

    labels.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/labels MCP labels_list

    List DevOps labels

    Board labels with their section (priority, urgency, area, topic, other) and colour token.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    sectionenumOne of priority, urgency, area, topic, other.
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "section": {
      "enum": [
        "priority",
        "urgency",
        "area",
        "topic",
        "other"
      ]
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    itemsobject[]required
    items[].idstringrequired
    items[].namestringrequired
    items[].sectionenumrequiredOne of priority, urgency, area, topic, other.
    items[].colorstringrequired
    nextCursorstring | nullrequired
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "section": {
            "enum": [
              "priority",
              "urgency",
              "area",
              "topic",
              "other"
            ]
          },
          "color": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "name",
          "section",
          "color"
        ]
      }
    },
    "nextCursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "items",
    "nextCursor",
    "rev"
  ]
}

    Example: Labels

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/labels" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "l-research",
      "name": "Research",
      "section": "area",
      "color": "teal"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}

    labels.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/labels MCP labels_create

    Create a DevOps label

    Add a label. id defaults to "l-" plus the name in lower case; a taken id or name gets 409. Colours: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky, purple, pink, lime, black, teal, indigo, rose, amber, brown, slate, red-deep.

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    idstring
    namestringrequired
    sectionenumOne of priority, urgency, area, topic, other.
    colorenumOne of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, sky, purple, pink, lime, black, teal, indigo, rose, amber, brown, slate, red-deep.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "id": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$"
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 40
    },
    "section": {
      "enum": [
        "priority",
        "urgency",
        "area",
        "topic",
        "other"
      ],
      "default": "other"
    },
    "color": {
      "enum": [
        "red",
        "orange",
        "yellow",
        "green",
        "blue",
        "sky",
        "purple",
        "pink",
        "lime",
        "black",
        "teal",
        "indigo",
        "rose",
        "amber",
        "brown",
        "slate",
        "red-deep"
      ],
      "default": "black"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "name"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    labelobjectrequired
    label.idstringrequired
    label.namestringrequired
    label.sectionenumrequiredOne of priority, urgency, area, topic, other.
    label.colorstringrequired
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    },
    "label": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "name": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "section": {
          "enum": [
            "priority",
            "urgency",
            "area",
            "topic",
            "other"
          ]
        },
        "color": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "name",
        "section",
        "color"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "rev",
    "label"
  ]
}

    Example: Research

    curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/labels" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"id":"l-research","name":"Research","section":"area","color":"teal"}'
    {
  "rev": 55,
  "label": {
    "id": "l-research",
    "name": "Research",
    "section": "area",
    "color": "teal"
  }
}
